name: Misty
source:
Misty is an independent girl with a strong passion for Water-type Pokemon. Due to her stubborn nature, she rarely relies on others and is sometimes even offended when offered help or consolation. Inherently tomboyish, Misty does make an effort fit in with her peers by spending time in local shopping districts on weekends.

Misty was first introduced in Pokémon Red, Pokémon Blue and Pokémon Green versions.
